correctness.rationale: For tent Q2=(1-|x|)_+ and ab=3/4 with b in [11/4,13/4], rational Zibulski–Zeevi p x q =3x4 fiber at x=t=0 evaluates exactly to [[c0,c,c,c],[c,c,c,c],[c,c,c,c]], c=2-3/b, c0=1 when b<=3 and 3-6/b otherwise. All eight lower-row arguments modulo 3 belong to [1/4,11/4] and only two nearest integer-period translates survive, endpoints included; c0-c=|b-3|/b. Rank is exactly 2 except b=3 rank1. Since Q2 is continuous in M1 and fiber continuous, rank defect at point excludes positive lower frame bound. Exact rational checks at five selected b corroborate, but distance argument establishes continuum.

originality.rationale: Theorem 7 of Lemvig–Nielsen arXiv:1507.03982 gives only [23/8,25/8] at ab=3/4; their Theorem 8 uses ab=5/6. Ghosh–Selvan arXiv:2310.01141 provides fiber matrix and a different family of exclusions; Lemvig arXiv:2601.07642 requires q>=6. The present full [11/4,13/4] interval is not implied by inspected theorem hypotheses. An earlier thesis may contain the identical row-equality trick; priority remains qualified.
residual_risks: An older thesis or nonindexed Gabor note might already include this enlarged interval.
Only a sufficient obstruction interval, not a proof of frame behavior outside or global optimality.
